statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-109908 is a heap out-of-bounds write in setCode() in src/encparse.c of X.Org libfontenc: the destination index is computed from the row size in the SIZE line of an .enc encoding file without a bound, so a crafted encoding file can write past the 0x10000-entry buffer. The CVE record lists libfontenc before 1.1.10 as affected (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-109908), and the fix is upstream commit 5920c6ee (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/xorg/lib/libfontenc/-/commit/5920c6ee144fffff84b62f5b479171f734f15316), which first ships in the libfontenc-1.1.10 release tag. DHI libfontenc for Alpine 3.24 builds upstream release tarballs from Alpine's APKBUILD. The DHI Alpine repository publishes two versions for Alpine 3.24, each as libfontenc and libfontenc-dev on x86_64 and aarch64: 1.1.9-r0, built in June 2026 from upstream 1.1.9 before the fix existed, and 1.1.10-r0, built from upstream 1.1.10, the release Alpine took as its security upgrade on 2026-11-18. The range ends at 1.1.10-r0, the first published build of a fixed upstream release.

CVE-2026-109908 is a heap out-of-bounds write in setCode() in src/encparse.c of X.Org libfontenc: the destination index is computed from the row size in the SIZE line of an .enc encoding file without a bound, so a crafted encoding file can write past the 0x10000-entry buffer, and the column check tested the global value1 instead of the from parameter. The CVE record lists libfontenc before 1.1.10 as affected (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-109908); the fix is upstream commit 5920c6ee (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/xorg/lib/libfontenc/-/commit/5920c6ee144fffff84b62f5b479171f734f15316). The Debian tracker lists trixie's 1:1.1.8-1 as vulnerable and the fix in 1:1.1.10-1 in unstable (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-109908). DHI libfontenc for Debian 13 rebuilds trixie's 1:1.1.8-1. The DHI Debian repository holds two builds of it, each as libfontenc1, libfontenc1-dbgsym and libfontenc-dev on amd64 and arm64, checked against the index checksums: the first is a plain rebuild, and the second backports that upstream commit, as its Debian changelog records. We located setCode() through the dbgsym symbols and disassembled it in libfontenc.so.1.0.0 and in the static libfontenc.a in libfontenc-dev: in the first build it loads the global value1 for the column check on both architectures, and in the second it no longer does, comparing the column of from instead, and on both architectures it adds a comparison of the computed index with 0xffff before the write. The range ends at the second build, the first published build with the fix.
